name: IBY_TEMP_EXT_PAYERS
description: IBY_TEMP_EXT_PAYERS is the interface table corresponding to IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYERS_ALL

columns.name: TEMP_EXT_PAYER_ID
columns.description: Primary key for this table. For Fusion, the value should come from Fusion common sequence - S_ROW_ID_SEQ

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the interface record.  Values are NEW, PROCESSED and REJECTED

columns.name: PAYMENT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Payment function from IBY_PAYMENT_FUNCTIONS lookup, i.e., CUSTOMER_PAYMENT

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to party at HZ_PARTIES_ALL.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: ORG_TYPE
columns.description: Organization type, such as business unit. Values taken from lookup: IBY_ORGANIZATION_TYPES

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: TCA Customer account ID

columns.name: ACCT_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: TCA customer account site use identifier

columns.name: BANK_CHARGE_BEARER_CODE
columns.description: Party that is responsible for paying regular or express bank charges, such as Payee or Payer. Values taken from lookup: IBY_BANK_CHARGE_BEARER

columns.name: DIRDEB_INSTRUCTION_CODE
columns.description: Direct debit instruction code

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DEBIT_ADVICE_DELIVERY_METHOD
columns.description: Used in upgrade.

columns.name: DEBIT_ADVICE_EMAIL
columns.description: Used in upgrade.

columns.name: DEBIT_ADVICE_FAX
columns.description: Used in upgrade.

columns.name: DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD
columns.description: Default payment method code; foreign key to IBY_FNDCPT_PMT_CHNNLS_B

columns.name: FEEDER_IMPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Feeder system assigned id for controlling the import process

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original system for external payer

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original system reference for external payer

columns.name: SERVICE_LEVEL
columns.description: Service level codes as prescribed by ISO20022 standards.

columns.name: LOCALINSTR
columns.description: Local instrument codes as prescribed by ISO20022 standards.

columns.name: PURPOSE_CODE
columns.description: Payment purpose codes as defined in the ISO20022 external code list.
